ADEA.name: Account Servicer Deadline Missed
ADEA.definition: Received after the account servicer's deadline.

DCAN.name: Denied Since Already Cancelled
DCAN.definition: Cancellation request was denied since the instruction has already been cancelled.

DPRG.name: Denied Since In Progress
DPRG.definition: Cancellation request was denied because the process of settlement is in progress.

DREP.name: Denied Since Repo Ended
DREP.definition: Cancellation request was denied because the repo was cancelled.

DSET.name: Denied Since Already Settled
DSET.definition: Cancellation request was denied because the instruction was already settled.

CDRG.name: Conditional Registrar
CDRG.definition: Execution is denied due to the execution of a process at the registrar.

CDCY.name: Conditional Currency
CDCY.definition: Execution is denied due to a process linked to the currency of the transaction.

CDRE.name: Conditional Realignement
CDRE.definition: Execution is denied due to the execution of a process of realignment at the issuer CSD.
